top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The hand washing sink in the infant classroom was observed being used to clean pacifiers as well as prepare bottles.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers do not have to review  a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solutions or wipes (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The antiseptic solution in the first aid kit was expired and there was not an additional one or antiseptic wipes on site.

top_violation_types.title: Update Admission Information - Procedure (26 TAC §747.609(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider does not have a system in place to update admission information.
